### Subject Definitions

The subject is a cute 3D cartoon monkey with rich brown fur, a light tan belly, large round expressive eyes, a broad smiling mouth, and blue cuffed denim jeans. The monkey is the same character as the reference image, sitting on a large grayish-brown rock in a sunny African savanna environment. The visual style is bright, polished 3D animation with warm golden daylight, clear blue sky, distant acacia trees, and golden grass.

### Summary

The monkey performs a cheerful rhythmic dance while remaining seated on the rock. It waves its arms alternately, twists its torso side to side, bobs its shoulders, and sways its long tail in time with the music. The dance is playful, energetic, smooth, and physically coherent. The camera remains mostly stable with a very gentle slow forward push. There is no dialogue, no narration, and no text on screen.

### Retention Analysis

Retain the monkey’s exact facial features, brown fur texture, light belly coloration, blue rolled-cuff jeans, body proportions, sitting position on the rock, and the original savanna background composition. Maintain the warm golden sunlight, bright blue sky, rocks, grass, acacia trees, and polished 3D cartoon rendering style. The monkey must not transform into a different animal or lose its clothing. Only dance motion and subtle camera movement are added.

### Detailed Description

0-5 seconds: The monkey sits on the rock and begins a happy seated dance. It raises one hand then the other, waving rhythmically while twisting its upper body left and right. Its shoulders bounce gently, its knees and feet move slightly to the beat, and its long curved tail swings back and forth in a smooth arc. The monkey’s expression remains joyful and animated throughout the clip. All movements are continuous, natural, fluent, and suitable for high-quality 3D character animation. The background remains stable, while the camera makes an extremely slow, subtle forward push. No sudden cuts, no text, no speech, no narration, and no subtitles.

### Overall Soundscape

The entire 5 seconds contains only background music with no voices, no narration, and no additional sound effects. The music is an upbeat, cheerful, bouncy instrumental track with a clear dance rhythm. It includes light percussion, warm melodic elements, and a playful tropical folk feeling. The music starts immediately and stays consistent until the end.

### Non-Diegetic Music

Bright playful dance instrumental music, moderate tempo, bouncy percussion beats, warm cheerful melody, full 5 seconds. The musical beats align naturally with the monkey’s arm waves, body twists, and tail sways. No lyrics, no singing, no spoken words.

### Subject Definitions

The main character is the original cute 3D cartoon monkey with thick brown fur, light tan belly, wearing cuffed blue denim jeans, big round eyes, and a joyful smiling face. A pair of large creamy-white golden-tipped angel wings grow from its back, matching the wing reference in shape, feather layout, pale gold color, and soft glowing texture. The monkey retains its original character design, fur texture, facial features, body proportions, and blue rolled-cuff jeans throughout the video. The visual style remains bright, polished Pixar-like 3D animation.

### Summary

After flying up from the African savanna through the atmosphere into outer space, the monkey changes from ordinary wing flapping into a playful, weightless spacewalk. It floats upward in zero gravity, takes slow swimming-like steps, gestures happily with its hands, and continues rising farther away from Earth while the wings occasionally adjust to stabilize its drift. The camera follows the monkey smoothly upward, no dialogue and no narration.

### Retention Analysis

Strictly retain the monkey’s original appearance, brown fur, light tan belly, blue cuffed jeans, facial expression, body proportions, and cartoon rendering style. Keep the angel wings consistent with the reference image in feather structure, pale golden color, and soft luminous edges. Maintain the continuous flight progression from savanna to sky to atmosphere to outer space. Do not change the monkey’s identity or clothing. Only modify the airborne motion into a weightless spacewalk.

### Detailed Description

0-2s: The monkey is still ascending from the bright African savanna into the blue sky with the large creamy golden wings spread on its back. It gives a few strong wing beats to gain altitude, then begins to enter a more relaxed, floating posture. The savanna ground and acacia trees shrink below.
2-5s: The monkey passes through clouds and the upper atmosphere. As gravity weakens, its motion changes into a playful spacewalk: it makes slow, exaggerated kicking movements, as if walking forward through the air, while its arms reach out gently and the wings flap only occasionally to stabilize direction. The sky gradually deepens into dark blue.
5-8s: The monkey reaches outer space, with the curved blue Earth visible below and tiny stars in the dark background. It continues the weightless spacewalk, taking slow floating steps upward, waving its hands happily, and twisting its torso slightly in zero gravity. The wings remain open and occasionally adjust with soft feather movement. The camera follows steadily upward, keeping the monkey as the central focus. No text, no speech, no subtitles.

### Overall Soundscape

Dreamy uplifting cinematic fantasy instrumental music, with a gradual increase in epic but gentle atmosphere. During atmospheric flight, include soft wind whoosh sounds; after entering outer space, replace wind with a very subtle deep-space ambient hum. Keep sound effects restrained. No human voice, no narration.

### Non-Diegetic Music

Warm, soaring, dreamy cinematic instrumental music, slow bright melody, soft strings and gentle cosmic pad sounds, lasting the full 8 seconds. The music swells subtly as the monkey enters space but remains smooth and non-diegetic. No lyrics, no singing.
